t.2682-20-4.agn: Present in products at very low concentrations; at these levels the pure substance's classes (acute toxicity, corrosivity) do not carry over to the label. What matters is skin sensitisation (Skin Sens. 1A): it can cause contact allergy even at low concentrations. It must be listed by name on the detergent label as a preservative.
t.2682-20-4.pw.0: A preservative that often causes contact allergy; if you are allergic to isothiazolinones, look for it on the label.
t.2682-20-4.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 613-326-00-9 (ATP13): Acute Tox. 2 (Inhalation), Acute Tox. 3 (Dermal), Acute Tox. 3 (Oral), Skin Corr. 1B, Eye Dam. 1, Skin Sens. 1A, Aquatic Acute 1, Aquatic Chronic 1. Supplemental label statement: EUH071.
t.2682-20-4.reg.det: Must be listed by name (INCI) on the detergent label as a preservative, whatever its concentration.
t.2682-20-4.summary: A preservative (biocide) from the isothiazolinone group.
t.2682-20-4.what: Prevents spoilage of water-based products by stopping bacteria and fungi from growing.
t.tem.h.H311: H311 Toxic in contact with skin.
